title: Photograph of round metal disc object with central opening (FBI flying disc file)
description: Black-and-white photographic print of a large, shallow circular metal disc with a raised rim, photographed from above against a dark background. A small circular opening sits at the center, a dark pointed object extends from the top edge toward the center, and a short tube protrudes from the lower left rim. The metal surface shows scratches, dents and dark stains.
